text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was passing through the shopping district,
I spotted Silence Suzuka wandering around
with a letter in hand.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Sp-Spe-chan...!
Haa, where could she be?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I thought she'd be somewhere around the post office...
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, Suzuka-san?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan...!
I came to deliver this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You forgot the letter that goes inside, Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh?! No way?!

Special Week hurriedly pulled out the envelope
and opened it inside—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's completely empty?!
Waaah, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
! You saved me~!
My mom would've been so bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, I'm just glad I caught you before you sent it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And... there's also something
I need to apologize to you for, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally read what was written on the letter.
It was dropped on the floor,
so just when picking it up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to pry, but...
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, j-just a bit, meaning,
umm, how much specifically...?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Just the first 3 lines or so?
About finding an upperclassman you look up to, and...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
How aside from becoming the number one horse girl in Japan,
you were able to find your own dream too...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
How the world started sparkling even brighter, and—
how glad you are to have met Suzuka-san, or something...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You read THAT far~?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No! That's not it!
If anything, thank you so much for bringing it to me,
Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But putting that aside, having it seen like that
right in front of me is, you know, kind of...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's the complete truth, and stuff I'm always
telling you anyway, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's still really embarrassing, desu ne...!
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it made me really happy.
The reason I ended up reading three whole lines was because
your feelings made me so happy, I just...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for looking up to me, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... The pleasure is all mine.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! As thanks for bringing my letter,
please let me treat you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's a Hokkaido fair near the station,
and my favorite local miso ramen shop
has a stall set up there~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Spe-chan's hometown...?
I'm definitely interested. May I?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Of course!

And so, the two of them happily
walked off toward the station together.
